kpis.description_fr: Backlog contractuel FY24. Visibilité ~1.6 année revenue. KPI clé CRO. Croissance ralentie post-2022 boom biotech funding.
kpis.description_en: FY24 contractual backlog. ~1.6 year revenue visibility. Key CRO KPI. Growth slowed post-2022 biotech funding boom.

kpis.description_fr: Net new business FY24 (signed contracts moins cancellations). Pression marché biotech (financement contraint). Book-to-bill <1.1x.
kpis.description_en: FY24 net new business (signed contracts minus cancellations). Biotech market pressure (constrained funding). Book-to-bill <1.1x.

kpis.description_fr: Marge op FY24. Best-in-class CRO (vs IQVIA, ICLR, CRL). Discipline pricing + scale.
kpis.description_en: FY24 op margin. Best-in-class CRO (vs IQVIA, ICLR, CRL). Pricing discipline + scale.

kpis.description_fr: Taille moyenne projet FY24. Mix shift vers Phase 2/3 plus larges. Specialization biotech mid-cap (vs big pharma).
kpis.description_en: FY24 avg project size. Mix shift to larger Phase 2/3. Mid-cap biotech specialization (vs big pharma).

kpis_story.description_fr: Marché biotech funding 2024 (XBI -10%) impacte directement Medpace (clientèle 80% biotech vs 20% big pharma). Signaux reprise 2025 : Fed cuts, M&A pharma, IPO biotech reprend. Net new business inflection attendu.
kpis_story.description_en: 2024 biotech funding market (XBI -10%) directly impacts Medpace (80% biotech vs 20% big pharma clientele). 2025 recovery signals: Fed cuts, pharma M&A, biotech IPO recovery. Net new business inflection expected.

_notes: Mid-cap biotech CRO specialist. Source: 10-K FY24 filed Feb 2025.
_score10_notes: MEDP only 3 truly specific 5y KPIs (Backlog, Net New Business, Avg Project Size). Op Margin banned as generic. Authorisations/cancellations data not consistently disclosed 5y.
_verification_note: 4 KPIs spécifiques CRO (Backlog, Net New Business, Op Margin, Avg Project Size). Source 10-K FY23+FY24+FY25 sec-data. Inférieur à 5 KPIs spec strict mais best-effort sur CRO mid-cap biotech.
